capability_investigated:
WhisperProcessor feature extraction and the batch shape that generate()
accepts: input_features is a fixed 30s (3000-frame) log-mel per call, and
generate(features, prompts) takes a stacked (N, mel, 3000) feature batch
with one prompt list per window.
what_i_learned:
The stub's single processor(audio) call hard-truncates each recording to
30 seconds — anything past the first window is never fed to the model, so
the dominant error is deletion of the entire tail, not a decode-quality
problem. Batching N stacked 30s windows through one generate() call returns
N independent result objects, one per window.
hypothesis:
Slicing the waveform into consecutive non-overlapping 30s windows and
batch-decoding all of them recovers the deleted tail; concatenating the
per-window decodes should sharply raise length_ratio and cut deletion-driven
CER versus the single-window stub.
